what: The two (or three) product cutouts are tied to scroll and fall diagonally from 120vh above to the outer 38vw at ±11° and settle into place. Horizontal uses power3.out and vertical and tilt use power2.out, so they first attach to the center and settle down later. The second starts 10% later in the fall range. Once in place, they bob up and down by .55em (second .7em) on a sine (3.4s, 3.9s, offset by .6s) and sway ±.7°. The floor shadow shrinks and fades as they rise (.9→1.02x). They tilt Y 7° and X 4.5° toward the mouse over the board and follow by .45em (.9s power3.out, second 1.3x)

options.[data-fx-part=item]: For each falling item, the part wraps the inside in three layers (.fx-dft__drop · __float · __tilt) and adds a shadow (.fx-dft__shadow). Item positions go in the consuming side’s css (the original uses 35% · 65% with bottom 19vh · 12.5vh).
options.[data-fx-part=light]: Light plate inside the object (optional) — brightens from .72 to 1 as it rises
options.drop-start · drop-end: Drop range (0~1) while the section is in progress, default .1 · .58 — the original is a 410vh section (margin-top −80vh) with a sticky stage
options.sx · lift · rot · lag: Side distance vw(38) · height vh(120) · tilt (10.5, first −11, second 10) · delay from the second (.1)
options.float · period: Rise and fall em(.55, next one +.15) · period s(3.4, next +.5)
options.start · end · scrub: ScrollTrigger range, default top top · bottom bottom · .4

use: …
note: Tilt only on devices with a pointer. With reduced motion, only the shadow moves while the element stays in place. On release, the wrapper layers are unwrapped and the original children restored

from.where: index.js closing section two pouches (original rat — dropStart .1, dropEnd .58, sx ∓38vw, rot −11/10, lag .1, −120vh, float .55/.7em 3.4/3.9s, rotation .7/−.8 ×1.27, tilt ry 7, rx 4.5, x .45em ×1/1.3)
